speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: MCCY's mission is to build social capital and inspire the Singapore Spirit.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We have come a long way as a nation in a short span of 50 years.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will build on the momentum from our SG50 Jubilee celebrations so that we embark on the next phase of nation-building with an even stronger sense of national identity and unity.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: Focused discussions will be organised by various Government agencies as we partner with citizens to make Singapore a better home.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: Through these engagements, we hope that Singaporeans will have a stake in our nation's future and will partner with us in shaping that future.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will engage youths on issues that matter to them.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will better support youths as they transit between life stages and rally youths to contribute to the community, so as to deepen their connection with the nation.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: Our confidence in the future is anchored on the firm foundation laid by our founding fathers and the contributions of the Pioneer Generation.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will do more to help Singaporeans appreciate and celebrate our history.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: The ongoing engagement process for the Founders' Memorial, overseen by a citizen-led Steering Committee, is an avenue for participants from all walks of life to share ideas on how the memorial should reflect our founding values and inspire future generations.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will continue to research, profile and preserve facets of our heritage that we treasure.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: The revamped National Museum and Asian Civilisations Museum and the new National Gallery Singapore will play a significant role in telling the Singapore Story for future generations and strengthening our national identity through their programmes and outreach initiatives.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will continue to extend pathways for arts and sporting excellence, to inspire greater national pride in the achievements of Singapore artists and athletes.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will continue to invest in strengthening Singapore's arts and sports ecosystem, to support our athletes' and artists' pursuit of excellence and professional development.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We want to make giving a part of our national DNA.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will work with partners in the people, private and public sectors to inspire a culture of giving.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We want to encourage volunteerism and philanthropy at every life stage, starting with our youths.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We want to inspire more working adults to volunteer and will engage employers and corporate partners to promote best practices for employee volunteerism.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will continue to work with partners to promote good neighbourliness and everyday norms of graciousness.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will strengthen mutual appreciation and cooperation through the Inter-Racial and Religious Confidence Circles, as well as increase community capacity in handling neighbour disputes.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: To encourage deeper community bonding through the arts and heritage, we will reach out to new audiences, especially in the heartlands, through PAssionArts programmes, community Heritage Institutions, Heritage Trails and Community Arts and Culture Nodes.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will also seek to strengthen cultural understanding within and between communities.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: Through sports, we will expand opportunities for Singaporeans to live better and bond as a community.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will enhance access to sports for all Singaporeans through improvements to sports infrastructure.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will also promote an active lifestyle and community bonding through ActiveSG programming.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: In the last 50 years, we made the leap from Third World to First World and built a cohesive society that we are proud to call home.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: Going forward, it is this solidarity and a shared sense of responsibility for the future of Singapore that will see us through to SG100.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We invite all Singaporeans to write the next chapters of the Singapore Story together, to make Singapore a better home for all of us.
